code:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .agents\skills | Out-Null
curl.exe -fsSL -o smo.zip https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BillJr99/Ursinus-CS357-Fall2026/gh-pages/files/small-model-orchestrator.skill
Expand-Archive -Path smo.zip -DestinationPath .agents\skills -Force; Remove-Item smo.zip
Get-Item .agents\skills\small-model-orchestrator\SKILL.md
description: PowerShell equivalent: creates .agents/skills, downloads archive, extracts it, and verifies SKILL.md.

steps.description: Download: curl.exe fetches the skill archive, saved as .zip.
Extraction: Expand-Archive extracts to .agents/skills, then removes the zip.
Verification: Get-Item confirms SKILL.md path exists.

title: Download and Install small-model-orchestrator Skill (PowerShell)
